concept_gloss.applicability: Bir isteği kabul ederken karşıdakine sevgi ve değer verildiğini de bildiren sözlerin genel açıklamasıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu kabulü, memnuniyeti ve karşıdakine değer verme işlevini korur.

concept_gloss.text: memnuniyetle kabul ve saygı bildiren kalıp yanıt

concept_map.definition: Bir öneri veya isteği memnuniyetle kabul ederken karşıdakine sevgi, saygı ve değer verme de bildiren kalıplaşmış yanıttır.

facets.statement: Konuşan, öneriyi veya isteği olumlu biçimde kabul eder.
Kabul, karşıdakine sevgi, memnuniyet ve değer verme duygusuyla güçlendirilir.
Aynı işlev, karşıdakinin kendisi veya gözü için değer bildiren çeşitli kalıp biçimlerle söylenir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir öneri veya isteğin sıcak ve istekli biçimde kabul edildiği yanıtta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu kabulü ve memnuniyet duygusunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabulün özellikle karşıdakine duyulan sevgi ve değerle gerekçelendirildiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabulü, gönüllülüğü ve karşıdaki kişiye değer verme yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel saygınlık veya genel onurlandırma değildir; bir öneri ya da isteğe verilen memnuniyetli kabul ve iyi dilek kalıplarıyla sınırlıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kabul edilen bir öneriye sevgi, memnuniyet ve karşıdakine değer verme ekleyen birkaç kalıp yanıt biçimi sunar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bunları kabul ve saygı bildiren sözler olarak doğru biçimde bir araya getirir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: senin için seve seve; sana duyduğum saygıyla

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kabul, memnuniyet ve değer verme bildiren belirtilmiş yanıt kalıplarına bağlıdır; yalın bir saygınlık anlamına genişletilmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; yalın olumlu yanıt ile övgü ve istek kalıplarını ayıran iki yakın komşu seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu yalın bir doğrulamadır; odak dal kabulü duygusal sıcaklık ve karşıdakini onurlandırma anlamıyla genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, olumlu yanıtın yanında memnuniyet, sevgi ve karşıdakine değer verme de bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca söyleneni doğrulayan veya soruya olumlu yanıt veren sade kabul sözüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da konuşmada olumlu yanıt ve kabul işlevi görür.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu övgü ve güçlü istek işlevlerine de uzanır; odak dal yanıt olarak memnuniyetli kabul ve saygı bildirmeye bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın çekirdeği, bir istek veya öneriye verilen memnuniyetli ve saygılı kabuldür.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: övgü, sıcak kabul ve güçlü istek kalıbı
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, kabul dışında doğrudan övgü ve bir işi yapmaya duyulan en güçlü isteği bildiren kalıpları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, sıcak kabul ve sevgi bildiren bazı kalıp sözlerde doğrudan kesişir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu sözleri olumlu kabulü sevgi ve değer verme duygusuyla güçlendiren yanıtlar olarak birleştirir; birden çok kalıp biçim aynı işlevi taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişisel olarak değer verilen kişi veya şeyi ve topluluk içindeki soylu temsilciyi birlikte açıklayan üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi ya da şey kapsamını, yüksek değeri ve topluluk içindeki seçkinlik kullanımını korur.

concept_gloss.text: değer verilen varlık ve topluluğun seçkin kişisi

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin gözünde çok değerli olan herhangi bir kişi veya şey ya da bir topluluğun soylu, saygın ve seçkin temsilcisidir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya şey, sahibi ya da ilgilisi için vazgeçilmesi zor derecede değerli olabilir.
Değer verilen kimse uğruna, kişinin değerli bulduğu başka şeyleri esirgememesi beklenebilir.
Topluluk yapısında söz, o topluluğun soylu, saygın ve seçkin kişisini belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin kendisi için çok değerli gördüğü insanı ya da nesneyi anlatan bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Değer veren kişiyi ve değer verilen kişi ya da şey kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: çok değer verdiği kişi veya şey

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğu temsil eden, soyu ve saygınlığıyla öne çıkan kişi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk bağını, soyluluğu ve seçkinliği korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca insanı anlatmaz; değer verilen bir şey de kapsama girebilir, topluluk kullanımı ise özellikle soylu ve seçkin kişiye bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yanda kişiye çok değerli gelen herhangi bir kişi veya şeyi, öte yanda bir topluluğun soylu ve seçkin temsilcisini anlatır. Verilen değerli kişi çerçevesi kullanılabilir, ancak nesneleri de kapsayan ilk kullanımla topluluğun seçkin kişisini anlatan ikinci kullanımın ayrılması gerekir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: senin için çok değerli olan kişi veya şey
topluluğun soylu, saygın ve seçkin kişisi

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişiye değerli gelen kişi veya şey kullanımını topluluğun seçkin kişisi yapısından ayırır ve bu yapılardan bağımsız yalın bir anlam varsaymaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; kişisel değer, korunmuş seçkinlik ve grup içinden seçilme sınırlarını gösteren iki ilişki yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda seçilme ve korunma belirleyicidir; odak dalda kişisel değer ilişkisi veya topluluğun soylu temsilcisi olma koşulu öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kişisel olarak değer verilen herhangi bir kişi veya şeyi ve bir topluluğun soylu temsilcisini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: seçilmiş, korunmuş ve en değerli varlık
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, kadın, topluluk, hayvan veya inci gibi varlıkların seçilmiş, korunmuş ve en değerli üyesi olma yönünü özellikle taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişi veya şeyler arasından çok değerli ve seçkin olanı anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu, seçkinlerden oluşan grup veya seçilmiş bölüm kavramına uzanır; odak dal kişisel değer ilişkisine ve tek bir soylu temsilciye bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, sahibine değerli gelen tekil kişi ya da şeyi ve topluluğun soylu temsilcisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir topluluk veya nesne grubunun seçkinleri, önde gelenleri ve geride kalan seçilmiş bölümü gibi çoğul kümeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal topluluk içinden seçkin ve üstün sayılan kişi alanında kesişir.

source_note.TA: Kişiye çok değerli gelen kişi veya şey ile bir topluluğun soylu ve seçkin temsilcisi iki bağlı kullanım olarak verilir.

text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًۭا

baseline.text: Ademoğullarına değer verdik; onları karada ve denizde taşıdık, kendilerine temiz şeylerden rızık verdik ve yarattıklarımızın birçoğundan üstün tuttuk.

findings.text: İnsan değeri, kara ve denizde taşınma ile temiz rızık tarafından çevrelenmiştir; üstünlük bu yüzden kendine yeterlilik değil, farklı ortamlarda sürdürülen ve hesabı sorulan donatılmış bir hareket imkânıdır.

activation_trace.role: Praiseworthy honor and generosity supply the governing grant and frame the later supports as enactments of dignity.
Visible bearing, including carrying people in a conveyance, makes supported mobility one material enactment.
An apportioned gift makes sustenance an assigned share rather than a self-originating possession.
The good, wholesome, pure branch qualifies the provision by usable quality, not quantity alone.
Degree and comparative distinction supply the verse's explicit relational ranking and emphatic close.

changed_reading.after: The verse depicts dignity as an enacted endowment whose visible components are supported mobility, wholesome allotment, and comparative capacity.
changed_reading.before: The verse gives humanity an abstract title of honor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated first-person-plural predicates honor, carry, provide, and prefer.
baseline_models.mechanism: Honor governs a sequence of enacted supports: bodies are borne across unlike media, apportioned wholesome sustenance, and given a comparative degree. Dignity is therefore operational rather than merely honorific.

activation_trace.role: Lineage and attribution to an origin make the honored subject a generated collective rather than an isolated abstraction.
Numerical abundance keeps the comparator field plural and leaves the preference explicitly over many.
Created existence supplies the common field within which the comparative distinction operates.
Increase and remainder render preference as a real added share beyond a baseline.

changed_reading.after: One lineage inside the created multitude receives a real added share over many comparators, while the wording withholds an all-creatures totalization.
changed_reading.before: Human beings are detached from all other creatures by an unqualified essence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Children of Adam, many of those created, and the doubled f-d-l expression.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lineage places the addressees inside a generated collective, while creation and multiplicity retain a wider comparator field. The increase-or-remainder branch of f-d-l makes preference an added share within creation, not verbal removal from creation.

activation_trace.role: Praiseworthy honor is the focus grant whose social visibility the Adam scene exposes.
Comparative degree anchors the focus verse to the preceding dispute over rank.
Lowering and submission make Adam's assigned station publicly enacted through the prostration command and its refusal.
Mixed clay supplies the low material substrate against which the assigned rank is non-self-evident.
Rivalry and being surpassed in nobility literalize Iblis's comparative protest and make honor a contested status.

changed_reading.after: Honor is an assigned rank within creation, publicly acknowledged yet exposed to rivalry precisely because it differentiates.
changed_reading.before: Honor is a serene species attribute needing no relational scene.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Adam scene turns honor and preference into publicly differentiating rank: commanded lowering acknowledges Adam, clay denies any obvious material basis for superiority, and Iblis restates k-r-m as the object of rivalry. The focus dignity is bestowed and visible enough to be contested.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prostration, clay, and Iblis's comparative k-r-m protest; I infer that 17:70's honor is publicly differentiating rather than private praise. A live alternative is that the prostration marks Adam's singular episode more narrowly than every descendant's standing.
structural_cues: 17:61 places Adam between a universal prostration command and one refusal.
17:62 repeats k-r-m with an explicit over-me comparison; its branchless h-n-k threat then targets Adam's descendants.

activation_trace.role: Lineage and descent anchor the focus collective to the threatened descendants and offspring.
Apportioned material benefit anchors the focus provision to the contested wealth channel.
Literal partnership supplies the mechanism by which an adversarial claimant enters human capacities rather than abolishing them.
Possessing and accumulating wealth identify a material channel through which endowed provision can be redirected.
Offspring from a lineage identify the generational channel through which Children of Adam continue and can be contested.
Deception by what glitters but does not endure explains how good-seeming capacities can be misread and recruited.
Power and jurisdiction are explicitly negated, bounding the adversary's participation short of ownership.
A guardian who sufficiently manages and preserves supplies the counterforce to attempted capture.

changed_reading.after: Bestowed dignity consists partly in consequential material and generational capacities that can be solicited and misused, while coercive ownership is bounded and faithful agency can be guarded.
changed_reading.before: Bestowed dignity functions as a secure status that adversarial influence cannot touch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The material and generational channels named by the focus verse are also channels of attempted capture: partnership enters wealth and offspring, glittering deception recruits desire, but coercive jurisdiction is denied and guardianship remains available. Dignity gives consequential capacities, not automatic incorruptibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted participation in wealth and offspring, deceptive promise, denied authority, and sufficient guardianship; I infer that the focus endowments are morally contestable capacities. Alternatively, 17:65 may describe a protected subset without characterizing dignity's general mechanism.
structural_cues: 17:62's branchless h-n-k threat targets Adam's descendants; 17:64 then names voice, mounted and foot forces, wealth, and offspring.
17:65 limits the no-authority assurance to God's servants rather than stating automatic immunity for every descendant.

activation_trace.role: Carrying people in a conveyance anchors the focus claim to the maritime mechanism immediately before it.
Gentle pushing and driving supply the causal propulsion hidden inside the focus verse's compact carried-them expression.
The ship moving through water supplies the concrete carrier by which sea mobility is mediated.
Seeking makes human effort real while directing it toward a benefit not generated by the seekers alone.
Unowed beneficence names the sought yield and links maritime movement directly to the focus preference vocabulary.
Merciful tenderness identifies the governing disposition behind the administered passage.
Release by separation supplies rescue as the decisive transition out of maritime danger.
Dry land supplies the receiving medium and completes the sea-to-land transfer later compressed into the focus pair.

changed_reading.after: Carriage over land and sea is supported passage: humans seek and travel, while propulsion, rescue, and the obtainable surplus remain administered mercy.
changed_reading.before: Carriage over land and sea celebrates autonomous human command of two environments.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sea sequence unfolds the focus verb carry: a ship is gently driven, people seek an unowed gift, and rescue transfers them back to land. Human mobility is real, but its propulsion, survivability, and yield are administered rather than autonomous.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gentle propulsion, ship, seeking favor, mercy, rescue, and arrival on land; I infer that these unpack the direction of 17:70's divine carrying. A live alternative is that they illustrate only one maritime instance rather than define every form of human mobility.
structural_cues: 17:66 places ship, sea, seeking, favor, and mercy in one causal sequence.
17:67 moves from distress at sea through exclusive appeal and rescue to land before human turning-away.

activation_trace.role: Dry land supplies one pole of the focus mobility pair and the first supposedly secure medium.
Broad abundant water supplies the other pole and the medium whose support can become engulfment.
Settled confidence supplies the security assumption that the paired warnings interrogate.
Earth sinking reverses dry land from a supporting surface into a withdrawing one.
A stone-bearing wind makes even the landward medium penetrable from above.
Rapid breaking supplies the destructive force of the sea wind and reverses supported conveyance.
Literal drowning supplies the terminal reversal of being carried over water.
Concealing a blessing links the physical reversal to failure to recognize the prior gift.

changed_reading.after: Honor grants supported reach across land and sea while leaving both media contingent; the gift is range under dependence, not immunity.
changed_reading.before: Honor through land-and-sea mobility implies environmental security or exemption from ordinary exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two media of human carriage are made symmetrically unstable: land can cave in or receive a stone-bearing wind, while sea can receive a breaking wind and drown its passengers. Concealing the gift links false security to failed recognition; honor provides range without immunity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies challenged security, land collapse, destructive winds, drowning, and concealed blessing; I infer that both media remain contingent on the giver who carries. Alternatively, the warnings may correct ingratitude without defining the essence of dignity itself.
structural_cues: 17:68 and 17:69 repeat the security question while alternating land and sea hazards.
Both warnings end by removing a protecting or pursuing counterparty, isolating the travelers from presumed control.

activation_trace.role: Comparative degree supplies the macro-level distinction that the next verse subjects to exact accounting.
Comprehensive totality prevents the honor claim from exempting any human collectivity from the summons.
A leader who is followed supplies the grouping relation under which each human collectivity is called.
Entering a name in a register or group makes identity and action individually legible within the collective.
Withholding a right is negated, making exact non-deprivation the governing rule of the audit.
The minute thread in a date stone supplies the scale at which non-deprivation remains operative.

changed_reading.after: Species-level distinction opens into exact personal and communal accounting; honored agency is legible down to the smallest withheld right.
changed_reading.before: Species-level preference is a collective privilege that can remain morally undifferentiated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus verse's species-level many and comparative degree open immediately into exhaustive grouping, leadership, recorded identity, and microscopic non-deprivation. Distinction does not dissolve persons into a privileged mass; it makes an accountable, legible agency possible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, exhaustive summons, group leadership, records, and microscopic non-deprivation; I infer that bestowed distinction entails accountable legibility. A live alternative is that 17:71 is only an eschatological sequel and not a specification of 17:70's honor.
structural_cues: 17:71 follows the honor verse without an intervening ayah and shifts from humanity as a lineage to every human grouping and its record.
The sequence narrows from all, to group and leader, to a person's book, and finally to a minute fiber.

activation_trace.role: Visible carriage supplies real movement-capacity and the physical side of the contrast.
Riding the sea makes the focus movement an active traversal whose destination still requires orientation.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies the inward incapacity that material mobility cannot cure.
Straying from guidance and intended direction turns movement into failed arrival.
An extended path supplies the navigable structure on which inward blindness becomes consequential.

changed_reading.after: Dignity equips movement but does not guarantee orientation; the carried traveler remains responsible for sight and path.
changed_reading.before: The ability to traverse environments is itself evidence of successful human direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Physical carriage across land and sea is set beside failed perception and a lost path. The contrast separates possession of movement-capacity from successful wayfinding: an honored traveler can still be unable to see where the path leads.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical carriage followed by blindness, straying, and path; I infer a contrast between mobility and orientation. Alternatively, 17:72 may describe a specific eschatological continuity rather than analyze the capacities named in 17:70.
structural_cues: 17:72 repeats blindness across this life and the next, then intensifies it with being further astray in path.

activation_trace.role: Praiseworthy honor anchors the proposed agency whose stability is tested in the later sequence.
Bearing a trust or burden supplies the ethical load that maintained agency must continue to carry.
Being bent away from truth supplies directional pressure on an honored human agent.
Strengthening and making firm supply the preserving intervention that keeps capacity aligned.
Inclining and settling toward something name the near-deflection that stabilization prevents.
A lightness that shakes stability supplies the social force attempting to dislodge the agent.
Forced movement outside supplies the threatened reversal of supported presence on land.
A continuously followed way supplies the stable rule against which attempted deflection is measured.

changed_reading.after: Dignity can be explored as burden-bearing agency preserved under pressure; honor names capacity and support, not self-stabilization.
changed_reading.before: Human dignity is a stable possession that persists without sustaining intervention or fidelity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The honored bearer can be pressured off truth, nearly lean, and be destabilized or expelled from land; strengthening preserves fidelity while the governing path does not change. Dignity appears as agency that must be maintained under force, not an automatically stable essence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, near-inclination, strengthening, destabilization, expulsion, and an unchanged way; I infer a maintained-agency model for focus dignity. The materially live alternative is that this sequence is prophet-specific and should not be generalized to Children of Adam without qualification.
structural_cues: 17:73-74 pair near-diversion with divine stabilization rather than with innate invulnerability.
17:76-77 pair threatened removal from the land with a continuing, non-convertible pattern.

remaining_uncertainties: How fully Adam's singular prostration scene transfers to every descendant remains open.
The phrase over many whom We created gives real comparison but does not settle the identity of every comparator or authorize an all-creatures totalization.
The ecological and answerable-gift outliers are branch-supported analogies, while the stabilized-agency delta may remain specific to the prophetic sequence.
strongest_changes: The Adam-Iblis frame converts k-r-m and f-d-l from generic praise into assigned, publicly contested rank within creation.
17:66-69 resolves land-and-sea carriage as divinely propelled and rescue-dependent mobility, then denies that such range grants immunity.
17:71-72 converts species-level distinction into exact accounting and separates physical movement-capacity from successful orientation.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus roots recur in adversarial, maritime, and audit scenes, allowing dignity to coexist as gift, exposed capacity, and accountable agency. Lexical side branches also opened contained ecological and answerable-gift readings without replacing the focus grammar.

activation_trace.role: Fertile rain, soil, and plant goodness recast honor as a life-supporting generativity beneath social rank.
A water-bearing cloud supplies a nonhuman carrier image that analogically supports human carriage.
Rain named as sustenance connects atmospheric carriage to the provision received below.
Good and wholesome products complete the ecological chain as its humanly usable yield.

changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the list can disclose human dignity as dependence on a bearing ecology: rain-bearing, fertile generation, and wholesome yield underwrite mobility and provision.
changed_reading.before: The verse lists social status, transport, and food as separate human privileges.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it temporarily maps human-directed predicates onto cloud, soil, and fruit images. It remains valid as a cross-domain activation because four focus roots explicitly carry rain, water-bearing, and provision branches in one anchored cluster. Downstream prose should render it only as an ecological substrate analogy, never as a replacement for the verse's grammar or agents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Honor, carriage, provision, and good things form a single support sequence in 17:70.

activation_trace.role: A gift that seeks recompense activates an answerable-gift image inside the focus act of honoring.
Apportioned giving supplies the concrete benefits to which an answering posture could respond.
Unowed beneficence prevents the response analogy from becoming payment for an earned wage.
Action met by its consequence supplies the nearby return structure that makes the gift answerable.
Concealing a blessing supplies the failed response that converts received support into accountable ingratitude.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form an advance gift that invites recognition; concealing the gift does not erase it but makes the recipient answerable for the response.
changed_reading.before: Honor and provision are status benefits with no response structure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Human honor is carried dependence, not autonomous elevation.** `ك ر م:B001/B010` values and honors, `ح م ل:B001/B006` bears a load with carrying means, `ب ر ر:B005` and `ب ح ر:B001` span land and sea, `ر ز ق:B001` allots gift, and `ف ض ل:B002/B003` rank as bounty. Honor is grammatically surrounded by carriage and provision. I infer distinction rests on sustained transport through unlike environments. The ayah corrects pride by making dignity a received mobility package.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:95's messenger-body calibration adds a communicative dimension to honor: embodied human form is not an obstacle but part of the provision suited to human ground.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Human honor as endowed mobility and access, not self-sufficiency.** Lexical evidence: `ك ر م B001` (praiseworthy nobility and generosity) in `كَرَّمْنَا`, `ح م ل B006` (carrying gear and mount) in `حَمَلْنَٰهُمْ`, `ط ي ب B001` (good and pure opposite foul) in `ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ`, and `ف ض ل B002` (rank and virtue) in doubled `فَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ/تَفْضِيلًا`. Structural cue: 17:66–69 has shown transport, danger, rescue, and the absence of independent terrain or guardian; this ayah gathers land and sea into one carrying claim before 17:71 restores individual books and judgment. Assigned role: carrying supplies mobility, pure provisions sustain it, and preference marks conferred rank. Abductive move: the packet attributes every capacity to prior gifts; I infer that honor consists in equipped possibility rather than immunity or autonomous power. Reading change: dignity is materially provisioned and therefore accountable, not a declaration that humans transcend the vulnerabilities just narrated.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:71 was decisive: the individual book and thread-fine justice make bestowed human mobility and rank answerable, correcting any reading of honor as unrestricted privilege.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive substantive meaning many, not all or most, as the comparison complement
words.prose: {{ar:كَثِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:kathīrin}}) is the first limiter on the climactic preference claim. It says many, not all, and not a superlative most. As a singular substantive complement after {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), it names an uncounted mass within the created order, then the following phrase narrows that many further.

words.gloss_range: contracted partitive preposition plus relative pronoun specifying the many as from those whom God created
words.prose: {{ar:مِّمَّنْ}} ({{tr:mimman}}) compresses two operations into one word: partitive selection and relative-clause introduction. It keeps {{ar:كَثِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:kathīrin}}) from floating undefined by specifying many from those whom God created. The relative pronoun can normally point to persons, but the creation clause widens the local frame to created beings generally.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form I divine creation verb inside the relative clause defining the comparison field
words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقْنَا}} ({{tr:khalaqnā}}) grounds the comparison group inside a relative clause: the surpassed many are from what God created. The verb leaves no explicit object after it because {{ar:مِّمَّنْ}} ({{tr:mimman}}) supplies the scope. The root can include fabrication, but divine first-person agency selects genuine origination and proportioning here, linking Adamic dignity back to the creation dispute (17:61).
words.root_gloss_range: creating, originating, fashioning, measuring, and fabricating; locally divine agency selects genuine origination and proportioning

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative Form II verbal noun functioning as cognate accusative for the preference verb
words.prose: {{ar:تَفْضِيلًۭا}} ({{tr:tafḍīlā}}) is not needed to complete the comparison frame; it is added after the verb, object, preposition, quantifier, and relative clause are already in place. As a cognate accusative, it confirms the act of preferring, repeats the same derived pattern as {{ar:فَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:faḍḍalnāhum}}), and makes preference the ayah’s final sound and concept. The same word in 17:21 has a Hereafter-ranking scope, while here the scope is humanity over many created beings.
words.root_gloss_range: preference, surplus distinction, and comparative ranking; locally the action-process of preferring is reinforced as the terminal seal
